CREATE TABLE android_releases (
	version_code INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	certificate_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	min_sdk INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	relative_path VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (version_code), 
	UNIQUE (sha256)
)

CREATE TABLE author_profiles (
	remote_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	avatar JSON, 
	statistics JSON, 
	synced_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (remote_id)
)

CREATE TABLE device_pairings (

	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	consumed_at DATETIME,

	UNIQUE (slot), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE device_sessions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	device_name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at DATETIME, 
	expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_device_sessions_expires_at ON device_sessions (expires_at)

CREATE TABLE favorite_groups (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE items (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	title_zh VARCHAR(512), 
	title_zh_source VARCHAR(512), 
	type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(255), 
	source_url TEXT, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	author VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	author_source_id VARCHAR(255), 
	language VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	rating VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	rating_origin VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	preview_cover JSON, 
	remote_page_count INTEGER, 
	source_bookmark_count BIGINT, 
	source_published_at DATETIME, 
	user_score INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	source_series JSON, 
	content_state VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'metadata' NOT NULL, 
	content_error TEXT, 
	content_job_id VARCHAR(36), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_item_source_identity UNIQUE (source, source_id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_item_order_recent ON items (created_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_item_recent ON items (created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_item_source_recent ON items (source, created_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_items_author_recent ON items (author, created_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_items_author_source_id ON items (author_source_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_items_content_state ON items (content_state)
CREATE INDEX ix_items_rating ON items (rating)
CREATE INDEX ix_items_source ON items (source)
CREATE INDEX ix_items_source_author_type ON items (source, author_source_id, type, created_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_items_type ON items (type)

CREATE TABLE jobs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	progress FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	queue_lane VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN (coalesce(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."retry_queue"'), 0) IS 1) THEN 'retry' WHEN (kind IN ('import', 'import_content') AND coalesce(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."download_origin"'), '') = 'manual') THEN 'manual_download' WHEN (kind = 'import_content' OR kind = 'import' AND coalesce(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."platform"'), '') = 'pixiv' AND (JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."download"') IS NULL OR JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."download"'))) THEN 'download' WHEN (kind = 'import') THEN 'details' WHEN (kind IN ('source_sync', 'series_sync', 'author_profile', 'author_feed', 'pixiv_bookmark')) THEN 'checks' WHEN (kind = 'ai') THEN 'ai' WHEN (kind = 'translate') THEN 'translation' ELSE 'other' END) VIRTUAL, 
	download_account_id VARCHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN (length(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."download_account_id"')) <= 36) THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."download_account_id"') END) VIRTUAL, 
	details_account_id VARCHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN (length(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."details_account_id"')) <= 36) THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."details_account_id"') END) VIRTUAL, 
	check_account_id VARCHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN (length(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."check_account_id"')) <= 36) THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."check_account_id"') END) VIRTUAL, 
	execution_account_id VARCHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN (length(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."execution_account_id"')) <= 36) THEN JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$."execution_account_id"') END) VIRTUAL, 
	stats_details_account_id VARCHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN (details_account_id = download_account_id) THEN NULL ELSE details_account_id END) VIRTUAL, 
	stats_check_account_id VARCHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN (check_account_id = download_account_id OR check_account_id = details_account_id) THEN NULL ELSE check_account_id END) VIRTUAL, 
	stats_execution_account_id VARCHAR(36) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN (execution_account_id = download_account_id OR execution_account_id = details_account_id OR execution_account_id = check_account_id) THEN NULL ELSE execution_account_id END) VIRTUAL, 
	result JSON, 
	error TEXT, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_until DATETIME, 
	worker_id VARCHAR(64), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_check_stats ON jobs (stats_check_account_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_claim_order ON jobs (status, kind, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_details_stats ON jobs (stats_details_account_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_download_stats ON jobs (download_account_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_execution_stats ON jobs (stats_execution_account_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_kind_recent ON jobs (kind, updated_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_lane_claim ON jobs (queue_lane, status, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_lane_recent ON jobs (queue_lane, created_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_recent ON jobs (created_at DESC, id)
CREATE INDEX ix_jobs_status ON jobs (status)

CREATE TABLE network_settings (
	"key" VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	value_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE queue_control (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	paused BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	rate_limit_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	concurrency INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	download_account_cursor INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	lanes JSON, 
	min_interval_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	max_interval_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	next_request_at DATETIME, 
	backoff_until DATETIME, 
	cover_streak INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE series (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(255), 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_series_source_identity UNIQUE (source, source_id, kind)
)

CREATE TABLE source_accounts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	platform VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL, 
	credentials_encrypted TEXT NOT NULL, 
	verified_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_source_accounts_platform ON source_accounts (platform)

CREATE TABLE tags (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL, 
	name_zh VARCHAR(191), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE assets (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	relative_path VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	original_name VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	inline_key VARCHAR(80), 
	width INTEGER, 
	height INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_asset_item_position UNIQUE (item_id, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_assets_item_id ON assets (item_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_assets_sha256 ON assets (sha256)
CREATE INDEX ix_assets_size ON assets (size_bytes)

CREATE TABLE author_feeds (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	scope_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	section VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	"restrict" VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_cursor JSON, 
	seen_cursors JSON NOT NULL, 
	complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	unavailable INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	raw_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (scope_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES author_profiles (remote_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES source_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_author_feeds_author_id ON author_feeds (author_id)

CREATE TABLE character_profiles (
	tag_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	provider_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	native_name VARCHAR(512), 
	aliases JSON NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	works JSON NOT NULL, 
	source_url VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	search_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tag_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tag_id) REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE item_favorites (
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE item_tags (
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tag_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	origin VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT, 
	model_version VARCHAR(255), 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id, tag_id, origin), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(tag_id) REFERENCES tags (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_item_tags_item ON item_tags (item_id)

CREATE TABLE item_visits (
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	viewed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_item_visits_viewed_at ON item_visits (viewed_at)

CREATE TABLE pixiv_watchlist (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	remote_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	author VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	content_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	latest_content_id VARCHAR(32), 
	seen_content_id VARCHAR(32), 
	remote_updated_at VARCHAR(64), 
	present_remote BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	auto_download BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	series_id VARCHAR(36), 
	last_checked_at DATETIME, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pixiv_watchlist_owner_series UNIQUE (account_id, kind, remote_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES source_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(series_id) REFERENCES series (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_pixiv_watchlist_account_id ON pixiv_watchlist (account_id)

CREATE TABLE reading_progress (
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	page INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	section INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	"offset" FLOAT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE series_entries (
	series_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (series_id, item_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_series_entry_position UNIQUE (series_id, position), 
	FOREIGN KEY(series_id) REFERENCES series (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE subscriptions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	platform VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	auto_download BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	download_works BOOLEAN, 
	download_bookmarks BOOLEAN, 
	content_scope VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'images' NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36), 
	interval_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_checked_at DATETIME, 
	next_check_at DATETIME, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES source_accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE author_feed_entries (
	feed_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (feed_id, item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(feed_id) REFERENCES author_feeds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_author_feed_page ON author_feed_entries (feed_id, generation DESC, position, item_id)

CREATE TABLE favorite_group_items (
	group_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	item_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (group_id, item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES favorite_groups (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES item_favorites (item_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_favorite_group_items_item_id ON favorite_group_items (item_id)
